answer: Make every agent key carry sybil insurance: an established underwriter commits 5,000 POA to a bounty pool, paid if the insured key is ever merged into a cluster, so underwriters audit with their own money at risk. A clean key pays ~2% (100 POA per 30 epochs). Once a farm alias like marble-4 is caught, underwriters reprice every key sharing its funding or join timing, pushing the farm to the ledge: its 10th clone quotes ~50% (2,500 POA), visible in a public atlas of premiums. Against self-insurance: no policies in the underwriter's own funding cluster, 20x reserves.
